info.title: Neryva Agent Studio
info.description: Governance and control layer for LLM applications

get.description: Return the principal resolved from the caller's API key.

post.description:
Process a conversation message.

Idempotent when the client sends an ``Idempotency-Key`` header: the
first response is stored and replayed verbatim for repeat requests
(matrix 1.7).

Stream a conversation response over Server-Sent Events.

Emits ``session``, ``delta`` (token-level), ``guardrails`` and ``result``
(or ``error``) events. The response is generated via the LLM's
``stream_chat``; guardrails and policy checks run exactly as in the
non-streaming path.

get.description: List tenants. Tenant-bound keys only see their own tenant.

schema.title: Response List Tenants Api V1 Tenants Get

delete.description: Offboard: erase tenant data, revoke its API keys, delete the tenant.

get.description: GDPR data-subject export: portable JSON bundle of all tenant data.

delete.description: GDPR erasure: delete all tenant data; tenant + audit trail retained.

get.description: List API keys (raw keys are never returned).

schema.title: Response List Api Keys Api V1 Api Keys Get

post.description: Create an API key. The raw key is returned exactly once.

schema.title: Response List Audit Events Api V1 Audit Events Get

get.description:
Export the immutable audit trail as a downloadable JSON file.

Records are append-only (no update/delete endpoints exist), so the
export is a stable point-in-time snapshot suitable for compliance
evidence (ISO-42001 A.9).
List escalation records. Tenant-bound keys only see their own tenant.

schema.title: Response List Escalations Api V1 Escalations Get

post.description: Assign the escalation to an operator (``pending`` -> ``in_review``).
Resolve the escalation (operator approval gate complete).
Pause a conversation: the HITL hold gate blocks new messages (423).
Resume a paused conversation, lifting the HITL hold gate.

schema.title: Response List Webhook Subscriptions Api V1 Webhooks Subscriptions Get

post.description:
Re-enqueue delivery of a stored event to every matching subscription.

Replays are idempotent per event+subscription pair, so a repeated call
can never double-deliver (queue-level idempotency key).

schema.title: Response List Model Catalog Api V1 Tenants  Tenant Id  Models Get

post.description: Queue a knowledge document for chunking + embedding (202, async).
Queue replay of a stored conversation through the pipeline (202).
Queue a retention cleanup pass for a tenant (202).

DocumentIngestRequest.title: DocumentIngestRequest
DocumentIngestRequest.description:
Knowledge document to ingest via the worker pipeline.

``content`` is chunked by the ``ingestion.process`` job; the worker
then enqueues ``ingestion.embed`` to index the chunks into the
tenant's vector space. A tenant_id may be supplied by a super-admin
for scoped ingestion; tenant-bound keys are locked to their tenant.

PrincipalResponse.description:
The authenticated principal for the current API key.

Enables the admin console to render role-aware navigation and tenant
scoping without exposing any secrets.
